content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD dispersion-term computation (BSD header L1-44). Single subroutine CAL_DISPERSION (L62-506), called by MAIN per header L46-51; history L53-59 records the 10/14/2012 change of derivative_xx_high to second order per Harris and the 08/2015 ykchoi corrections to U1p,V1p,V2,V3,omega_1. Structure: (a) spatial derivative preparation — DERIVATIVE_XX/XY/XY/YY of U,V into Uxx,Uxy,Vxy,Vyy with MASK9 (L77-83); with CARTESIAN and Gamma2>0 also Ux,Vx,Uy,Vy,ETAx,ETAy (L87-93), else ETAx,ETAy only when SHOW_BREAKING (L94-100). (b) DU,DV = max(Depth,MinDepthFrc)*U,V and mass-flux-based surface time derivative ETAT(I,J)=-(P(I+1,J)-P(I,J))/DX-(Q(I,J+1)-Q(I,J))/DY over J=1..Nloc-1,I=1..Mloc-1 (L103-119; comment L111 records ykchoi 05/25/2018 pointing a bug that the loop should be J=1,Nloc,I=1,Mloc; comment L109: Etat for (U1p)_t in conservative form of Shi et al. (2012) and wavemaker viscosity). (c) CARTESIAN Gamma2>0 block: backward-difference time derivatives Ut=(U-U0)/DT, Vt=(V-V0)/DT and DUt,DVt (L133-142; Steve Brandt note L126-128 that Ut,Vt should be evaluated outside the RK loop, kept temporarily; empty SHOW_BREAKING/WAVEMAKER_VIS ELSE branch L144-149). (d) derivatives of DU,DV (DUxx,DUxy,DVxy,DVyy L152-158) and, for Gamma2>0, DUx,DVx,DUy,DVy,Utx,Vty,Utxx,Vtyy,Utxy,Vtxy,DUtx,DVty,DUtxx,DVtyy,DUtxy,DVtxy (L162-182). (e) boundary zeroing of the eight cross-derivative arrays Uxy,DUxy,Vxy,DVxy,Utxy,DUtxy,Vtxy,DVtxy at Ibeg (west, skipped for LEFT_BC_IRR wavemaker, L196-209), Iend (L225-234), Jbeg (L248-257), Jend (L271-280), each guarded by PARALLEL MPI_PROC_NULL and COUPLING IN_DOMAIN checks; then CALL EXCHANGE_DISPERSION (L289). (f) main dispersion loop J=1..Nloc,I=1..Mloc (L293-384): CARTESIAN U4,V4 = (1/3-Beta_1+Beta_1^2/2)*h^2*(Uxx+Vxy etc.) + (Beta_1-1/2)*h*(DUxx+DVxy etc.) (L296-299); ykchoi 04/14/2017 nonlinear addition for gamma2>0 using ken1,ken2 eta-dependent coefficients times gamma2*MASK9 (L302-318); ZALPHA variant of U4,V4 (L322-328); U1p,V1p with the ykchoi-corrected leading coefficient 0.5*(1-Beta_1)^2*h^2*(Uxx+Vxy) + (Beta_1-1)*h*(DUxx+DVxy) (CARTESIAN L337-346; non-CARTESIAN L349-357 plus SPH_EXTRA_DISP spherical extra terms with tan(Lat_theta)/R_earth factors using VxL/VxR,HVxL/HVxR averages for U1p L361-365 and UxL/UxR,VyL/VyR,HUxL/HUxR,HVyL/HVyR,V,HV for V1p L369-378). (g) AB_OUTPUT diagnostic gradients grdAx,grdAy,grdBx,grdBy (L386-395). (h) CARTESIAN gamma2>0 second loop over Jbeg..Jend,Ibeg..Iend (L399-501): central x/y derivatives of the grouped quantities UxxVxy,UxyVyy,HUxxHVxy,HUxyHVyy (L403-415), depth slopes rhx,rhy (L418-419); time-dispersive terms U1pp,V1pp from ETAx/ETAy,Utx+Vty,Utxx+Vtxy,DUtx+DVty,DUtxx+DVtxy with Beta_2 factors (L422-426) plus ykchoi remaining Shi et al. (2012) terms via ken1..ken4 involving ETAT (L430-436); nonlinear convective dispersion U2 (L447-455) and V2 (L461-469) with coefficients ken1..ken5 (L438-445, ken1 redefined for V2 at L459 per ykchoi note L457-458); vorticity omega_0=Vx-Uy (L471), correction omega_1 with b2 and Beta_1 coefficients per Shi et al. (2012) (L475-476), omega=omega_0+omega_1 (L478) with VorticityMax tracking when OUT_VORmax (L480-484); vortical terms U3=-V*omega_1-omega_0*(ken1*HUxyHVyy+ken2*UxyVyy) (L486-493) and V3=U*omega_1+omega_0*(ken1*HUxxHVxy+ken2*UxxVxy) (L496-498).

verbatim_spans.text: ! 05/25/2018, ykchoi pointed a bug: J=1,Nloc, I=1,Mloc
! as pointed by Steve Brandt, Ut and Vt should be evaluated outside of RK loop.
! U1p, V1p terms are modified to 0.5_SP*(1.0_SP-Beta_1) --> 0.5_SP*(1.0_SP-Beta_1)*(1.0_SP-Beta_1)
!remaining terms in U1p, V1p in Shi et al. (2012) publication
! ken1 should be modified as following term.

unresolved: ETAT loop runs J=1,Nloc-1 and I=1,Mloc-1 (L103-104) leaving ETAT undefined at I=Mloc and J=Nloc rows, and the in-code comment L111 says ykchoi flagged this (should be J=1,Nloc, I=1,Mloc) — the loop bounds were not changed in this source

The IF(SHOW_BREAKING .OR. WAVEMAKER_VIS) branch at L144-149 (and its non-CARTESIAN twin L146) has an empty body before ENDIF — the intended ETAT-related computation for that case is absent or handled elsewhere
Ut,Vt evaluated inside the RK loop against Steve Brandt's advice (L126-128), kept 'temporarily' pending tests per the comment — behavioral impact and hot-start implication undetermined from this file
U1pp/V1pp appear only in the CARTESIAN gamma2>0 second loop (L422-436) while U4/V4/U1p/V1p are set in the first loop; how these terms combine into momentum equations happens in other files
b2 (lowercase, L475-476) vs Beta_2 both appear in omega_1; the definition and value of b2 and Beta_1/Beta_2 are in GLOBAL/PARAM elsewhere; whether b2==Beta_2 is not decidable here

VorticityMax update (L482) stores signed omega when abs(omega) exceeds VorticityMax — a negative omega with large magnitude overwrites the stored max, making 'VorticityMax' signed rather than a magnitude maximum

The first dispersion loop runs to Mloc,Nloc (L293-294) reading Uxx etc. computed only on Ibeg..Iend interior plus ghost fills from EXCHANGE_DISPERSION (L289); validity at outermost ghost cells relies on the PHI_COLL fills in bc.F
